description: This file defines a journaled Orleans grain called CountersGrain that manages counters with event sourcing. It includes nested classes for state and events, and methods for updating, resetting, and retrieving counter states.

classes.name: CountersGrain
classes.description: A journaled Orleans grain that manages counters with event sourcing, supporting operations like add, reset, and state retrieval.

classes.name: CountersGrain.GrainState
classes.description: Nested class representing the grain's state, which is a dictionary of counters.

classes.name: CountersGrain.UpdatedEvent
classes.description: Event class representing an update to a counter.

classes.name: CountersGrain.ResetAllEvent
classes.description: Event class representing a reset of all counters.

methods.name: OnActivateAsync
methods.description: Handles grain activation, performing lazy load setup.

methods.name: Add
methods.description: Adds a specified amount to a counter identified by key, with optional confirmation wait.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets all counters, with optional confirmation wait.

methods.name: ConfirmAllPreviouslyRaisedEvents
methods.description: Confirms all events that have been raised previously.

methods.name: GetTentativeCount
methods.description: Retrieves the tentative count for a specific key.

methods.name: GetTentativeState
methods.description: Retrieves the tentative state of all counters.

methods.name: GetConfirmedState
methods.description: Retrieves the confirmed state of all counters.
